WCAG Accessibility Audit - Complete Documentation Index

This directory contains a comprehensive WCAG 2.1 accessibility audit for the Jeremy R. Winget personal website/blog (Quarto-based).

Audit Date: November 2, 2025 Overall Status: Partially Compliant (WCAG AA with remediation needed) Issues Found: 13 (4 Critical, 5 Major, 4 Minor) Estimated Fix Time: 2.5-3 hours

Documentation Files

1. WCAG_ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT.md (29 KB)

Complete detailed audit report with technical analysis

This is the primary comprehensive audit document. Contains: - Executive summary - Detailed findings for all 13 issues - Color contrast analysis with exact ratios - Alt text and image accessibility review - Semantic HTML structure evaluation - Keyboard navigation and focus indicator assessment - Screen reader compatibility analysis - WCAG criterion references (WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA) - Detailed recommendations with code examples - Impact analysis for each issue - Priority remediation plan (Immediate/High/Medium) - Testing recommendations and tools - Full references and conclusion

Best For: - Understanding the full scope of accessibility issues - Technical deep-dive on color contrast ratios - WCAG criterion references - Stakeholder communication - Comprehensive documentation

2. ACCESSIBILITY_SUMMARY.md (5 KB)

Quick reference guide - one-page overview

High-level summary of critical issues. Contains: - Overview with issue count and severity breakdown - Critical issues (4) with exact locations and fixes - Major issues table with current/needed values - Color fixes summary with SCSS code - Image alt text needed (organized by blog post) - Form HTML before/after comparison - Testing checklist - Files to modify list - Links to full documentation

Best For: - Quick reference during implementation - Executive briefing - Sharing with team members - Getting the “at a glance” view - Printing as a checklist

3. REMEDIATION_GUIDE.md (14 KB)

Step-by-step implementation guide with exact code changes

Complete walkthrough with specific file locations and code. Contains: - 6 remediation sections (Color/Button/Form/Images/Logo/Skip-link) - Exact line numbers for each change - Before/After code examples for every fix - Explanation of what changed and why - Affected elements for each change - Color palette changes with contrast verification - Form HTML updates with semantic markup - Image alt text examples by blog post - Verification checklist after each fix - Testing tools and instructions - Success criteria list - Estimated time per remediation

Best For: - Implementation and coding - Developers fixing the issues - Copy-paste reference for code changes - Ensuring nothing is missed - Verifying fixes are complete

Quick Start Guide

For Project Managers/Stakeholders

  1. Read: ACCESSIBILITY_SUMMARY.md
  2. Understand: 13 issues, 2.5-3 hour fix window
  3. Verify: Estimated costs/timeline

For Developers

  1. Read: ACCESSIBILITY_SUMMARY.md (1 minute)
  2. Reference: REMEDIATION_GUIDE.md (step-by-step fixes)
  3. Check: WCAG_ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT.md (detailed specs)

For Accessibility Auditors

  1. Read: WCAG_ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT.md (full audit)
  2. Verify: REMEDIATION_GUIDE.md (fixes match requirements)
  3. Test: Using tools listed in audit document

Summary of Issues by Category

Color Contrast Issues (7 issues)

  • Link hover color: 2.63:1 (CRITICAL - needs 4.5:1)
  • Warning color: 2.19:1 (CRITICAL - needs 4.5:1)
  • Secondary text: 2.89:1 (MAJOR - needs 4.5:1)
  • Gray-600: 3.90:1 (MAJOR - needs 4.5:1)
  • Form note text: 3.90:1 (MAJOR - needs 4.5:1)
  • Info color: 3.15:1 (MAJOR - needs 4.5:1)
  • Danger color: 3.82:1 (MAJOR - needs 4.5:1)

Image Accessibility Issues (4 issues)

  • Missing alt on logo (MAJOR)
  • Missing alt on 5+ blog images (CRITICAL)
  • Missing alt on code-generated charts (MAJOR)
  • Missing alt on featured images (MINOR)

Form Accessibility Issues (1 issue)

  • Form accessibility issues: Missing label, no focus indicator (MAJOR)

Focus Indicator Issues (1 issue)

  • Subscribe button missing focus indicator (CRITICAL)

Remediation Priority

IMMEDIATE (1 Week) - Critical Issues

  1. Fix link hover color contrast (10 min)
  2. Fix warning color contrast (5 min)
  3. Add alt text to critical images (30 min)
  4. Add subscribe button focus indicator (5 min)

Total: 50 minutes

HIGH (2 Weeks) - Major Issues

  1. Fix secondary text color (10 min)
  2. Fix gray-600 color (10 min)
  3. Fix form note contrast (5 min)
  4. Fix info color (5 min)
  5. Fix danger color (5 min)
  6. Fix form accessibility (15 min)
  7. Add logo alt text (5 min)

Total: 55 minutes

MEDIUM (1 Month) - Minor Issues

  1. Add skip-to-content link (15 min)
  2. Add code-generated chart alt text (1 hour)

Total: 75 minutes

Grand Total: ~2.5-3 hours

Key Findings

Strengths

  • Strong semantic HTML structure
  • Good responsive design
  • Proper heading hierarchy
  • Excellent navigation aria-labels
  • Good form input focus indicators (except button)
  • No time-based or auto-playing content
  • Text is resizable with relative units

Weaknesses

  • Color contrast issues with secondary colors (Flatly theme limitation)
  • Missing alt text on important diagrams
  • Missing form label
  • Missing button focus indicator
  • Missing skip-to-content link

Easy Wins

  • Color palette changes (7 changes, 30 minutes)
  • Button focus styling (1 change, 5 minutes)
  • Alt text additions (10+ images, 45 minutes)

WCAG Compliance Target

Current Status: Partially Compliant

After Remediation: WCAG AA Compliant - 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text - 3:1 for large text - Meaningful alt text for all images - Keyboard accessible forms - Visible focus indicators - Semantic HTML throughout
